headline: Names a post office in Elfers, Florida after Private First Class Felton Roger Fussell.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4122 Madison Street in Elfers, Florida, as the Private First Class Felton Roger Fussell Memorial Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the new name applied from that date.
